scope: Correct DWG/DXF MLINESTYLE angle-unit conversion and retain source-frame evidence. The generated angle codec and an independent DXF readback provide bounded evidence; strict DWG-to-DXF output remains unqualified because the MLINESTYLE raw callback is required to retain source identity and bytes.

dwgSpecification.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
dwgSpecification.section: §20.4.73 MLINESTYLE: startang and endang are BD fields

authority.compatibilityBasis: The public DRW_MLineStyle/DXF model keeps angle fields in degrees, matching resetDxf defaults, DXF groups, and LibreCAD consumers. DWG BD fields are converted to/from radians at the DWG codec boundary.

source.producer: LibreDWG dwgadd 0.14 plus local LibreDWG C API mutation helper
source.mlineStyleProfile: Standard; two elements at offsets +0.5 and -0.5; BYLAYER colors and linetypes; 90-degree start and end caps
source.independentDwGObservation: LibreDWG reads the source MLINESTYLE start/end angles as 1.5707963267948966 radians.

changes: The typed MLINESTYLE callback and its auxiliary raw DWG callback are both retained. Physical AC1027 source auditing demonstrated that the raw callback supplies source-frame bytes, identity, and common links needed to bind the typed record.
DRW_MLineStyle::parseDwg converts DWG BD radians to public/API degrees and refuses a non-finite converted result.
DRW_MLineStyle::encodeDwg converts public/API degrees to DWG BD radians. DXF parse/write continue to use degree-valued groups directly.
The public field comments now state the degree-based API unit and DWG wire unit.

dwgObjectVectors.coverage: AC1024 MLINESTYLE independent wire walk confirms degree-to-radian encoded angles and same-object parse returns public degrees; AC1032 hard-pointer path also checks angle roundtrip.

focusedCtests.selector: libdxfrw_dwg_object_vectors, libdxfrw_ac1032_mlinestyle_handle_roles, libdxfrw_mlinestyle_cmc_retention, dwg2dxf_mline_style_typed_capture_limits, libdxfrw_mline_style_objects_allocation, libdxfrw_mline_style_body_transactions, libdxfrw_mline_source_dependency, libdxfrw_mline_style_authority
focusedCtests.result: PASS 8/8 after restoring the source-preserving raw callback

writerTransactionMatrix.result: PASS within the restored-route focused set; includes seven-revision ASCII/Binary writer rollback, retry, and typed readback matrix

currentStrictConversion.result: Expected strict refusal: source read publishes 30/30 frames, then output refuses the unqualified MLINESTYLE raw callback at handle 0x18/type 73 (qualified=4/5). This preserves source evidence and is not a parser failure.

supersededStrictConversionExperiment.result: Not valid support evidence. Conversion passed only while the raw MLINESTYLE callback was suppressed, which caused the physical AC1027 source audit to lose the type-73 source frame. That suppression has been reverted.

independentReadback.result: The experimental DXF bytes contain 90-degree fields, two elements, and the expected offsets/colors/linetype sentinels; this validates the encoded values only, not the current DWG-to-DXF source route.

physicalSourceFrameAudit.result: PASS: 111/111 frames publish; the 84-byte type-73 MLINESTYLE handle 0x18 has owner/reactor 0x17 and ACAD_MLINESTYLE dictionary membership key Standard. LibreDWG minJSON independently matches type, size, owner, and reactor. Audit disposition: 88 opaque callbacks, 75 retained opaque frames, 13 retained standard objects, zero undecoded body-reference profiles.
physicalSourceFrameAudit.semanticLimit: This audit validates frame identity, common links, and dictionary membership, not typed MLINESTYLE scalar/element fields or native rendering.

limitations: The DWG source and generated files are scratch/local research inputs; no DWG/DXF fixture is added to the repository.
Current strict conversion refuses the MLINESTYLE source callback because typed source-frame binding and writer admission are not qualified. Do not suppress the raw callback to pass the output gate.

The AC1027 source audit proves identity/common-link/dictionary closure only; semantic fields, arbitrary trailing-body preservation, MLINE entity geometry, LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3 rendering, and FreeCAD/native application behavior remain open.
P6-D remains open for per-version source-bound field/no-loss census and broader independent semantic evidence.
